abstract: Pure endodermal sinus tumor (EST) of the ovary is an uncommon germ cell tumor characterized by rapid growth. Its occurrence during pregnancy is extremely rare. The case of a 34-year-old woman with EST stage IC diagnosed in the 22nd week of gestation is presented. She received four cycles of cisplatin monotherapy during pregnancy. Further, three cycles of combination chemotherapy (cisplatin, bleomycin, and etoposide) were administered. Twenty-eight months posttreatment the patient was in complete remission with good health. A healthy female infant was delivered by cesarean section in the 35th week of pregnancy. The child showed normal laboratory, pediatric, and neurologic examination at the time of discharge from hospital and during the first and second years of her life. We conclude that the prognosis of EST is very good if patient receives adjuvant therapy. Cisplatin monotherapy seems to be effective and safe during pregnancy.
abstract_ja: 卵巣の純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍(EST)は、急速な増大を特徴とする稀な胚細胞腫瘍である。妊娠中の発症は極めて稀である。本報告では、34歳女性が妊娠22週に病期ICの卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された症例を示す。妊娠中にシスプラチン単剤療法を4サイクル受け、その後シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドの併用化学療法を3サイクル受けた。治療から28か月後も完全寛解で健康であった。妊娠35週に帝王切開で健康な女児が出産された。出生後の検査、小児科的評価、神経学的検査は正常で、1歳および2歳の時点でも正常であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍の予後は補助療法を受ければ非常に良好であると考えられる。妊娠中のシスプラチン単剤療法は有効かつ安全と思われる。
